If a live channel has shown no picture by this time, MyIPTV stops trying and tells you, instead of leaving a black screen while it works through every player it has. Never keeps trying, which can take well over a minute on a channel your provider has removed. Waits your provider asks for are not counted.

This device does not allow MyIPTV to set exact alarms, so a recording may begin a few minutes late. Recordings start earlier to make up for it.

On any device with a browser on the same Wi-Fi — a phone, a computer or another TV — scan the QR (or open the URL), enter this PIN, choose your MyIPTV backup file and send it. You then pick what to restore here.
MyIPTV could not work out how many channels this provider allows.

Many providers never say how many channels you may watch at the same time, so MyIPTV finds out by opening a few and seeing which ones survive. Anything playing now will stop, and this can take up to two minutes.
Surround — send Dolby/DTS to a real 5.1/7.1 receiver. If it goes silent or stutters, MyIPTV still falls back to stereo and tells you.

MyIPTV is a media player only. It includes no channels, playlists, or content. You are responsible for adding your own legally accessible Xtream, M3U, or Stalker sources.
